truth_policy: No truth in inference, anchor, curvature, bounds, budget or candidate generation; score selected candidates only after every C process completes
host_audit_arithmetic: C double state/Jacobian; exact affine-amplitude reordering and long-double response/cost accumulation; no outward rounding claim

interpretation.individual_or_region_budget_failure: Sufficient bound fails to qualify; no conclusion that the actual candidate is inaccurate or excluded
interpretation.conditional_step: Other candidate coordinates held at anchor; full joint uncertainty retained
interpretation.coverage: Neither a passing local budget nor numerical falsification validates confidence coverage
interpretation.no_reanchor: All full/scaled/conditional candidates refer to the same original anchor; none is applied
